scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic Jacobian and nonresonant cubic coefficient verified; numerical orbit samples are corroborative, not a proof of existence. Standard local Neimark–Sacker theorem supplies existence conditional on analytically checked hypotheses.
scientific_limitations: Local near a single positive coexistence state, a fixed self-limited quadratic Gause flow, and Euler step near 2; no global positive-quadrant invariance, invariant-circle rotation type, or other-parameter family classification claimed; historical priority and independent validation outstanding.
title: An exact supercritical Euler-induced oscillatory circle below a descending prey nullcline
